answers.goal:
I have no specific role in mind, but I would describe it with these words:

Dance, film, behind the scenes, photography, concerts, marketing, campaigns, social media, videography, advertising, editing, big studios, production…

Wherever these takes me, I’m happy!
answers.drew: It’s the reason why I moved here, combined with the dance and performance industry. I’m a big fan of hiphop dance as well. Los Angeles is also an amazing place to network, especially in this industry. My passion is within it, and therefore I want to do my best to fill my life with as much joy and experiences as possible here. Big focus on the career as well, and how I can come forward with my creativity.
answers.seeking: People that would like photos, videos, someone that can help with editing, creating videos. In other words, people that also look for others to create projects.
answers.inspiration: Los Angeles and the dance industry here. It has opened op so many doors for me, also connected to filming and capturing photos. And just to be in the audience for live taping is a memory I will keep for the rest of my life. Might not sound cool for others, but for nye, it has brought so much inspiration. And that it’s possible to actually work with your passion.
answers.favorite: Vampire Diaries! Off campus was pretty good as well
